stage0210_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$かなめ$$
「The reason I asked you all to stay after school
　is none other than...」

stage0210_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$アルト$$
「If you have something to say, make it quick.」

stage0210_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$n
「We promised $$小野Ｄ$$, $$風間$$, and the others
　we would go eat at Galaxy Ramen.」

stage0210_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Sorry, but you will have to cancel.」

stage0210_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$かなめ$$
「...I hereby announce the launch of a major project
　concerning the future of your student lives.」

stage0210_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$甲児$$
「This sure came out of nowhere...!」

stage0210_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$かなめ$$
「It'll let Sousuke and the rest of you
　enjoy life as high school students while...」

stage0210_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$かなめ$$
「...still doing your best on missions to fight
　all sorts of enemies of peace. Miss $$スズネ$$ and I
　came up with one grand plan...」

stage0210_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Okay, dismissed.
　Let's go get that ramen already.」

stage0210_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$クラン$$
「Now hold on, all of you.
　$$かなめ$$ went to the trouble of planning this.」

stage0210_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ルカ$$
「That's right.
　Rejecting it before hearing her out is too harsh.」

stage0210_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Just what I'd expect from $$クラン$$ and $$ルカ$$!
　You two actually understand how people feel!」

stage0210_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Unlike the rest of you...!
　What do you take my kindness for!?」

stage0210_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$甲児$$
「H-hey...!
　What happened to 'Sorry I keep getting mad'
　from the school trip!?」

stage0210_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$かなめ$$
「That was about everything up till now.
　From now on, we're insiders sharing a secret,
　so I won't be pulling any punches!」

stage0210_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$かなめ$$
「But listen, $n...
　This project of mine
　is for your sake too.」

stage0210_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$かなめ$$
「To explain that, I need to tell you
　what this project is meant to do.」

stage0210_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Ever since you all transferred in,
　a lot of people have questioned your behavior.」

stage0210_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$アルト$$
「Well, that's no surprise.
　Late arrivals, early exits, then that school trip.」

stage0210_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$さやか$$
「To the other students,
　we must look like a bunch of real troublemakers...」

stage0210_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$甲児$$
「At my old schools,
　I took pride in always doing everything right...」

stage0210_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ボス$$
「Big talk for the shadow boss...!」

stage0210_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$かなめ$$
「And thanks to Sousuke's bizarre behavior,
　the faculty has you marked
　as a whole group of freaks.」

stage0210_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$かなめ$$
「...Speaking of Sousuke, where is he?」

stage0210_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$n
「When class ended,
　he said he had plans and left.」

stage0210_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Finding out what those plans were
　is your job, $n!」

stage0210_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$n
「I knew it would come to this...」

stage0210_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ is doing her best too,
　but even she can only cover for you so much.」

stage0210_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$かなめ$$
「To solve this problem, we need
　a legitimate reason for all of you to act together
　and do unusual things.」

stage0210_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$アルト$$
「So that's what the club is for...
　Then Captain $$クラン$$ and $$ルカ$$ moving together
　wouldn't seem unusual.」

stage0210_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$n
「Then we can all work together
　to stop $$宗介$$'s bizarre behavior...!?」

stage0210_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$さやか$$
「$n... This really has been getting to you.」

stage0210_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$かなめ$$
「The members won't be limited to everyone here.
　We'll interpret extracurricular work broadly and
　recruit from nearby elementary and middle schools.」

stage0210_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$アルト$$
「So $$ワッ太$$ and $$正太郎$$ can join too.」

stage0210_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Exactly.
　And if we call them off-campus activities,
　late arrivals and early exits can be excused.」

stage0210_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$甲児$$
「Now that sounds good...!
　That's our class rep!」

stage0210_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「So what sport will we play?
　Or will it be a culture club, like astronomy
　or building robots?」

stage0210_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$かなめ$$
「No, no!
　We could never escape the teachers' scrutiny
　with activities like that!」

stage0210_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Besides, clubs like those already exist,
　and we'd be in trouble if we had to compete.」

stage0210_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$n
「Then what are we going to do?」

stage0210_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Heh heh... Heh heh heh heh heh heh!」

stage0210_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$アルト$$
「I've got a bad feeling about this...」

stage0210_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$かなめ$$
「The club you're all going to form...!
　It will be...!」

stage0210_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$アルト$$
「I've got an even worse feeling about this...」

stage0210_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Yes, President $$林水$$!
　The Volunteer Club's work won't be limited to campus,
　but will extend beyond it...」

stage0210_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Without fail, it will make Jindai High's name
　resound throughout $$第２新東京市$$!」

stage0210_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$スズネ$$
（I knew I could count on you, Chidori...
　With you in charge, everyone's student lives
　will be in safe hands...）

stage0210_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I've already asked Miss $$スズネ$$ to be our advisor.
　All we need now is the student council's approval...」

stage0210_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$林水$$
「Though it is a request from you, the vice president,
　and I fully agree with its purpose,
　I regret that I must deny it.」

stage0210_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Why!?
　Please tell me your reason!」

stage0210_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$林水$$
「There are two reasons...
　First, any new club founded at our school
　must begin as an interest group.」

stage0210_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$林水$$
「And you know several groups that lack the record
　needed for club status and have reluctantly
　remained mere interest groups.」

stage0210_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$林水$$
「The other is that the concrete benefits
　to Jindai High remain unclear.」

stage0210_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$かなめ$$
「But as I said, volunteer work
　would enhance Jindai High's reputation...」

stage0210_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$林水$$
「Volunteer work based on that premise
　would be hypocrisy, would it not?」

stage0210_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$林水$$
「Do not misunderstand me.
　I too accept the saying, 'Even hypocrisy is good.'
　In that regard, I do not oppose a Volunteer Club.」

stage0210_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$林水$$
「But I cannot accept devoting a precious club slot
　to something as vague
　as recognition from outsiders.」

stage0210_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$かなめ$$
（Th-this isn't working...
　As expected of $$林水敦信$$, renowned as
　Jindai High's greatest mind...）

stage0210_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$かなめ$$
（I can't bulldoze him like I can everyone else...）

stage0210_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$林水$$
「It is too soon to be discouraged, Chidori.
　There is a way to solve both problems at once.」

stage0210_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Huh... The Z File?
　The one collecting all Jindai High's problems...?」

stage0210_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$林水$$
「Volunteerism means the spirit of service...
　If you can solve this school's problems,
　I will recognize you as an official club.」

stage0210_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$蓮$$
「For the immediate future, these are the two issues.」

stage0210_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$林水$$
「Hmm...
　Catching the pervert said to appear nearby,
　or helping another club...」

stage0210_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$スズネ$$
「If this is enough to make us give up,
　we'll never be able to face the hardships ahead.」

stage0210_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$スズネ$$
「And both would help people in trouble...
　They're perfect for the Volunteer Club's first job.」

stage0210_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$林水$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ is exactly right.
　That is precisely why I want the Volunteer Club
　to clear this assignment.」

stage0210_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Understood.
　I'm ready to see this through.」

stage0210_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$林水$$
「Then, though you are not yet an official club,
　we shall have Miss $$スズネ$$, as the person in charge,
　decide which problem you will address.」

stage0210_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$林水$$
「Will you pursue the pervert,
　or help another club...?
　Which will it be?」

stage0210_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$スズネ$$
「To protect the students, we'll pursue the pervert.」

stage0210_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$林水$$
「Understood.
　Then we will have Mikihara prepare the materials.」

stage0210_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$林水$$
「And this is a good opportunity.
　Allow me to introduce a new student council member.」

stage0210_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Sousuke!
　What are you doing here!?」

stage0210_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$林水$$
「I have appointed him student council president's aide
　in charge of security.」

stage0210_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$宗介$$
「President Hayashimizu recognizes my abilities.
　As a member of this school, I intend to handle
　security on campus and in the surrounding area.」

stage0210_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$林水$$
「Naturally, I also know he is a member
　of the Volunteer Club （tentative）.」

stage0210_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$林水$$
「This matter should serve equally well
　as Sagara's first assignment and as a test
　for the Volunteer Club （tentative）.」

stage0210_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$かなめ$$
「President, once we solve this case...」

stage0210_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$林水$$
「I understand.
　I will approve the Volunteer Club's formation.」

stage0210_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
Hayashimizu
「I, $$林水敦信$$,
　promise on my name as Jindai High's council president.
　I have faith in your success.」

stage0210_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$宗介$$
「We will not fail to meet your expectations.」

stage0210_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$かなめ$$
（Is this the bad feeling $$アルト$$ was talking about...?）

stage0210_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$スズネ$$
「To support the students working so hard,
　we'll help another club.」

stage0210_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$林水$$
「Understood.
　Then we will have Mikihara prepare the materials.」

stage0210_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$林水$$
「And this is a good opportunity.
　Allow me to introduce a new student council member.」

stage0210_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Sousuke!
　What are you doing here!?」

stage0210_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$林水$$
「I have appointed him student council president's aide
　in charge of security.」

stage0210_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$宗介$$
「President Hayashimizu recognizes my abilities.
　As a member of this school, I intend to handle
　security on campus and in the surrounding area.」

stage0210_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$林水$$
「Naturally, I also know he is a member
　of the Volunteer Club （tentative）.」

stage0210_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$林水$$
「This matter should serve equally well
　as Sagara's first assignment and as a test
　for the Volunteer Club （tentative）.」

stage0210_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$かなめ$$
「President, once we solve this case...」

stage0210_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$林水$$
「I understand.
　I will approve the Volunteer Club's formation.」

stage0210_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
Hayashimizu
「I, $$林水敦信$$,
　promise on my name as Jindai High's council president.
　I have faith in your success.」

stage0210_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$宗介$$
「We will not fail to meet your expectations.」

stage0210_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$かなめ$$
（Is this the bad feeling $$アルト$$ was talking about...?）

stage0210_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, well. It seems $n and the others
　have decided to pursue the pervert, but...」

stage0210_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What could the pervert's true identity be!?
　Do not miss the next episode as the storm gathers!」

stage0210_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Just kidding. I thought I'd hype it like a preview.
　Now, let's get fired up today too... business, business!」

stage0210_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well now, it seems $n and the others
　have agreed to help out a school club...」

stage0210_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Who knows which club they'll end up helping...
　And what awaits them, a storm or a thunderbolt?」

stage0210_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Or so I say, stirring up a little anxiety.
　Time to work hard today too... Business, business!」
